parts: When we checked on November 24, 2026, BUR BUR's site ran a banner for "30% off sitewide" with its own Black Friday code. sections.h2: 2. Subscribe to the oil if you'll reorder
parts: The Growing Season oil can be ordered as a subscription, delivered every 30, 45 or 60 days, at 15% off each delivery. That's $47.60 a bottle without a code. If you'd buy it again anyway, the subscription saves the same as the code on every refill.

sections.h2: 3. Buy a bundle instead of single items
parts: The bundles already cost less than their parts. The 3 Pack of oil is $149 against $168 for three bottles, and the Mermaid Bundle of oil and brush is $120 against $134 listed. Add the bundle, enter {code}, and check whether the code applies to it at checkout.

Standard shipping in the US is free on orders over $65; priority shipping starts at $10. A single bottle of oil is $56, so a second item, such as the $46 Deep Repair Mask, gets you past the threshold.

BUR BUR says US orders take 3 to 4 business days to process and 3 to 5 business days to arrive, and orders after 2 p.m. Pacific are processed the next business day. When we checked, its product pages asked for 5 to 7 extra business days because of high order volume. It ships to 179 countries; international delivery takes 3 to 18 business days, and some countries, including Italy, Spain, Greece, Mexico and Vietnam, aren't served.

You have 14 days after delivery to request a return by emailing support. Items must be unopened and in their original packaging, and sale items and gift cards can't be returned. If the return is accepted, BUR BUR sends a return label; return shipping is refunded only when the item was faulty or the mistake was the brand's. Our [BUR BUR review](saving-tips-bur-bur-review.html) sums up the ratings and the fine print.
